Next obtain independent massive-electron CM 5D heat with Pauli and quantitative energy-grid/cutoff convergence at T/me=0.1,1,10. Never infer physical gamma or 86-eV relic from algebraic checks.

Quantitative h,ℓ,cutoff,dt convergence and error budget; nonmonotone finite-grid case included
